status: design-only oracle DATA, defined BEFORE any harness exists; NOT a harness, NOT an A0.7 run, NOT a marker, NOT production anchor geometry
independenceStatement: These expected values are derived ONLY from the fixture's known construction (US-Letter mediaBox [0 0 612 792], two pages) and from the documented normalization formula below. They are INDEPENDENT of any future harness/code under test (ADR §3); a future harness MUST be compared against these pre-recorded values, never have its own output back-filled into this oracle.

expected.pageIndexConvention: 0-based (PDFKit page(at:)); index 0 = physical page 1, index 1 = physical page 2
expected.normalizationFormula: nx = x / width, ny = y / height (normalize); x = nx * width, y = ny * height (denormalize). Page-box extent only; no rotation, no origin transform, no viewport/pixel mapping.

tolerance.rule: A value passes iff |observed - expected| <= absolutePdfPoints for box extents and for denormalize-roundtrip recovery of PDF-space points. Normalized components are compared with the same 1e-9 absolute tolerance. The transform is divide-then-multiply, so genuine error is at floating-point noise (<< 1e-9); 1e-9 catches real instability while permitting FP noise (ADR §3).
tolerance.units: PDF points (1 pt = 1/72 inch) for PDF-space values; dimensionless for normalized components

resultInterpretation.pass: Every asserted value (page count, per-page mediaBox extent, sample-point normalize/denormalize roundtrip) is within tolerance.
resultInterpretation.fail: At least one asserted value is outside tolerance. Subject to ADR §4 classification (Class-1 normalization/math bug vs Class-2 geometry-source instability). A Class-2 fail is an architectural STOP and MUST NOT be downgraded to green.
resultInterpretation.inconclusive: The harness could not produce a comparable value (fixture failed to load, geometry unavailable, environment unsupported). INCONCLUSIVE IS NOT PASS and MUST NOT advance the gate.

hardConstraints.notProductionAnchorGeometry: These are fixtures/oracle values only — NOT production anchor geometry (no rotation, no captured-geometry versioning, no persistence, no viewport mapping).
hardConstraints.notImplementedIsFail: Until a real A0.7 harness exists and runs against this oracle, the A0.7 status is not_implemented, which is a FAIL — never a pass (ADR §4/§6; evidence-genie.md invariant 10).
hardConstraints.noMarkerFromArtifactsAlone: No A0.7 marker may be written from this manifest/oracle alone. A marker requires a real harness producing provenance-valid classified-pass evidence, and the tamper/fabrication guard must be in place first (ADR §5, §8). dev-memo/run/evidence/** remains absent.
